steps.name: Haze
steps.text: 'Kitties.'

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: 'Kitties,' of all shapes and sizes.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: How to put it, meow...

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Let's suppose, from tip to tail of town, out came cute little things... hm, and let's also assume you like cute things.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: They'll appear by your side, without warning or whisper.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: But they'll only wander into your life on some certain day.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Kitties aren't like people. They won't cozy up to you just because you're so upstanding, and they won't abandon you just because you're some petty thief.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Are there kitties who bask in the sun in coffee shops? There are. Black kits who give night guards a scare when they flash by? Yes.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Even in jail, jail so stunningly strict... kitties can still tiptoe right in, and leave without a hair out of place.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Oh, I might just really love them. No matter which kitty it is, I can feel just how they feel. I don't want to get up. I'm hungry. It's warm. You know what—I'd like to play a prank.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Everything is a kitty's whim.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: How could a person ever learn to be as easygoing as a kitty? Kitties don't ever band up to bully a single cat.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Ah. They're not like livestock or housepets. Don't think of keeping kitties, or shutting them in.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: I hear tell that anyone who'd want to hurt a kitty, in the end, would never even find a single one.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: ...Haze, Haze!

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Meow?

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: You're okay, right?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Mmn... Was I off saying things again just now?

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: You suddenly ducked down muttering something, and then you wouldn't say anything at all, like you'd fallen fast asleep.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: My, my, this hat is incorrigible, scaring people by raving lunatic and arcane. It does ab—solutely nothing to fit my style.

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit said that when Operators display this sort of loss of self-conscious response, we have to report it to Medical straight away...

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Oh, I'm fine, I'm fine meow. I wouldn't be caught dead on those bloody infirmary beds. The kitties by my feet are just too adorable, and I couldn't help losing myself in loving them.

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: Haha. There's always so many kitties around Mousse, that's why.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: And what a mewtiful thing! For absolute kitty-addicts like me, Mousse becomes an indispensable part of life...

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Heheh, they're all so kind. That's why they've been protecting me since I was back in Victoria...

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: ...Haze?

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: (She's in another daze...)

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Haze?

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: ...Miss Haze!

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Myah! ...I'm—I'm alright.

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: What's weighing on your mind, Haze? You've been paying extra attention to our surroundings since a bit ago.

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: (Whisper) C—Could it be a scent? Has something dangerous sneaked into the Rhodes Island base?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: It's not, I just... happened to notice woman of distinction passing by.

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: Woman of...?

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Distinction...?

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Ah! You mean Miss.Christine? I didn't detect her at all.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: It's clear to see while all the kitties around gather in the plaza to bask and frolic, Miss.Christine doesn't seem one bit taken by it.

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: Miss.Christine is a very self-determining kind of kitty. She prefers quiet, lonely places.

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: Now that we mention it, that sounds familiar. You usually love playing about with us, but in front of Miss.Christine, you turn all quiet.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Because... there's a deep, very familiar sense of respect living in Miss.Christine. I can't help it when I gaze at her.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Could it be, you've met Miss.Christine before, Haze?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: How could an escapee like me hope to know a kitty of her status? No, it's—her manner, graceful, unhurried, self-pleasing. Not one bit unlike some 'benefactors' who aided me in the past.

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: Are you talking about...

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Well, well... a bygone tale already, is it... myah-hah-hah, this hat's off on its crazed ramblings again. Steals away my attention without notice if I'm not careful.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Mm! Mousse, Mint, treat all of that jabber as my joke!

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: But I know there's no joke here.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: To anyone else, a fugitive like me is just as good dead or alive... some might even curse me.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Society has the type who find joy in evaluating other people's worth. Being bullied by them is far from new for me.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: It was harder than you'd believe to escape that prison... my sickness hit me worse and worse.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: But in catching this nuisance of a disease, I caught an absurd, hitherto unpossessed hope too, the capacity to put my Originium Arts to full use...

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: With the catch that at first, it did absolutely no good.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Once they all saw the cuts only an Infected could have, even the nicest baker's lady wouldn't pass a crumb of old bread onto me.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: I had a mind to use the power of my Arts to strike up terror in those shopkeepers' hearts... but then it slipped far out of my control, and blew straight through an entire neighborhood's worth of houses.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: That kind of barbarous strength could never take me back to my normal life in Victoria. I understood that inside and out.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: But, well, you know horrid 'nuisances' like me could be dead or alive to anyone else...

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: If even my own self turns a blind eye to my life, what other need is there to be alive?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: However—I wouldn't like to die.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: I spent such a tremendous amount of effort to escape that prison by the skin of my teeth, and yet I found not one person in the whole of Victoria who had any concern left for me, any willingness to accept me...

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Not even... a sliver of charity to give.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Look at me, in that state. Imagine if I'd never met 'it.' If I'd never met 'them.'

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: I was near to forgetting why I bothered with my escape in the first place.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: My, have mew been standing here for long, Doctor?

options: You taking a stroll just like the 'kitties'?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Hah-hah. I'm shirking exactly nothing. It's a break between shifts right now, and my stroll has the right to go anywhere it wants.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Doctor, did you know? When you care too much about something, it's all too easy to let the important things slip you by.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: This pen from your pocket, for example. Could I have the honor of using it for a day?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Let me say upfront: I'm not trying to hide anything under the covers here. I'm just plainly, simply greeting you face-to-face. Right, plain and simple.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Ah. See, Miss.Christine's noticed your scent too. She's taken an even higher-up ceiling strut to rest on.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Meow? Yes, that's right, I was staring at Miss.Christine a moment ago.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: I just stopped in my tracks to admire her. Observing from beyond, at a distance that won't put her on alert. Up until you passed by, Miss.Christine and I were getting along like a house on fire.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Hm? Why don't I try chit-chatting with Miss.Christine, is it?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: There once was a kitty with quite a resemblance to Miss.Christine who, back in my Victorian days in hiding, came to my help.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Gave me food to eat, offered me clothes to huddle in, led me to dingy little alleyways and warehouses where I could hide from the hunt for me...

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: After some time, when I'd finally learned a little Arts, I wanted to find that kitty again. Repay it, you know.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: I'd gotten such splendid food in comparison, such warm clothes I'd pilfered to offer it, and all it ended in was my forsaken, lonely exit from the streets.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: *sigh*... Doctor, why is a raven like a writing desk? Why must we meet at three in the afternoon? Why do perfectly decent people take the fall for the awful, and why does misfortune prey on good people?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Why... am I unable to live as a kitty does?

options: My unjust past isn't your fault.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Hah-hah... meow unbecoming of me, Doctor.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: That certainly wasn't Haze grumbling to you. If you were just subject to someone rattling strange things off at you, it's alright now.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: That moody, depressing little scamp. I choked the life out of it myself only a meowment ago.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: If I—If Haze loved whining so much, then she would've looooo—ong, long ago crumbled under the weight.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: But she—I've been through everything, followed my heart for everything, came to Rhodes Island holding my faith in myself dear.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: That's quite the extraordinary feat to pull off, isn't it? Myah-hah-hah.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Well, then, have your pen back. *yawn*—It's about time I find a nice spot to sway my tail and have a nice sleep...

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Mreow? Yaah—!

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Ah! I found Haze!

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: Haze, are you okay?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Oh, it was just a trifle. Simply wasn't looking and fell right down. No need to worry, Mint, Mousse, Doctor.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Knew it—you love running off to hide every time there's a health checkup. The Medic Operators tasked us to take you with us to the consultation room, or bust!

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Tsk... it's so cruel to make me stare down the state of my own health.

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: Haze?

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: No, it's alright. I suppose it's good of Rhodes Island's doctors to keep some form of privacy. Let's take a siesta for a while first, before we visit that dreadful, disinfectant-stinking room.

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: Bu—But you almost fainted a moment ago...

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Look at that, I have Mint and Mousse with me too. You won't be one bit late carrying me over after I faint for real.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: And the Doctor's right here as well.

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: No—can—do—! Health maintenance is incredibly important! Um, though we don't really qualify as 'healthy' people...

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Leave the meat of the lecture until after we find those adorable little kitties, and have ourselves a proper group lie-down. Mousse, where have those kits gone to rest today?

steps.name: Mousse
steps.text: Hm? I-If I had to guess, probably in the Garden...

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Then time's of the essence. Let's convene the kitties right now and tour around the Garden together!

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Ah, Doctor, you're still here.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: As you can see, I'll be taking a nice, lazy afternoon nap, getting a pre-departure physical exam done and dusted, and then I'll report in with my team, and we'll start today's acts of 'chivalry.'

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Coming from a former thief and a criminal on the run, it might be quite ironic to hear.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: But, Doctor, as far as I'm concerned now, this is quite nice.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: As things stand, my strange little self somehow has battles to fight for the sake of saving others, and thus the chance to be approved of by more and more people...

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Doctor, you're not like those once-adorable twice-adored kits, and versus one of refined manners and a concern only for her own freedom like Miss.Christine, you're a world apart.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: I just can't make heads or tails of you... but I know that here and now, you're partial to frolicking about with me, and willing to entrust missions to me with proud and confident airs.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: If you ask me, having earned that much from you makes me absolutely content.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Myah-hah-hah, that's what you wanted to say, wasn't it, you lunatic little hat? So long, meow revoir!

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: Meow.

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: Meow!

options: That kid just now, she really likes you.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Yes, rather than my 'liking' kitties, it might be better to say I revere them.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Or, perhaps... envy them.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: It's an envy which, at some times, compounds my frustrations.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: Ah, humanity... always this way. Any one of its desires coming about can carry unforeseeable dangers. Pay a shred of attention less, and you'll cause yourself to fall into the straits of distress.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: That said... never anticipate a kitty's actions based on your own dear wishes.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: They're kitties. Free, merry, lucky, ill-omened, saddened kitties.

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: What's more important is they do as they please, come and go unfettered, with none of those complicated human social devotions. They simply enjoy life, full stop—

steps.name: Haze
steps.text: After all, what could people ever hope to demand from a kitty?
